post.description:
Use this API to create a B2C Order in Anchanto WMS.

      ### 📋 Request Templates (Copy & Paste)

      #### 1. Standard Order
      ```json
      {
        "b2c_order": {
          "shipping_type": "standard_delivery",
          "payment_collection_name": "online",
          "currency_code": "USD",
          "order_items_attributes": [
            {
              "sku": "SKU123",
              "quantity": 1,
              "unit_price": 100,
              "item_udfs_attributes": {
                "Color": "Red",
                "Size": "Large",
                "Material": "Cotton",
                "Style": "Casual",
                "Pattern": "Striped",
                "Design": "Flowers",
                "Embroidery": "Yes"
              }
            }
          ],
          "billing_address_attributes": {
            "first_name": "John",
            "address1": "123 Main St",
            "city": "City",
            "zipcode": "12345",
            "country_iso": "US",
            "state_abbreviation": "NY",
            "phone": "1234567890"
          },
          "shipping_address_attributes": {
            "first_name": "John",
            "address1": "123 Main St",
            "city": "City",
            "zipcode": "12345",
            "country_iso": "US",
            "state_abbreviation": "NY",
            "phone": "1234567890"
          },
          "carrier": {
            "carrier_code": "DHL",
            "carrier_name": "DHL Express"
          }
        }
      }
      ```

      #### 2. Historical Order
      ```json
      {
        "b2c_order": {
          "is_historical_order": true,
          "b2c_order_state": "completed",
          "b2c_shipment_state": "delivered",
          "wms2_order_state": "completed",
          "created_at": "2023-01-01T10:00:00Z",
          "updated_at": "2023-01-02T10:00:00Z",
          "tracking_number": "TRACK123",
          "dispatch_no": "DISP123",
          "dispatch_date": "2023-01-01T12:00:00Z",
          "delivered_at": "2023-01-02T10:00:00Z",
          "originated_from": "Shopify",
          "shipping_type": "standard_delivery",
          "payment_collection_name": "online",
          "order_items_attributes": [
            {
              "sku": "SKU123",
              "quantity": 1
            }
          ],
          "billing_address_attributes": { ... },
          "shipping_address_attributes": { ... },
          "carrier": {
            "carrier_code": "DHL",
            "carrier_name": "DHL Express"
          }
        }
      }
      ```

      #### 3. Order with VAS (Value Added Services)
      ```json
      {
        "b2c_order": {
          "shipping_type": "standard_delivery",
          "payment_collection_name": "online",
          "order_vas": ["Gift Wrapping", "Quality Check"],
          "order_gift_message": "Happy Birthday! Enjoy your gift.",
          "order_items_attributes": [
            {
              "sku": "SKU123",
              "quantity": 2,
              "unit_price": 100,
              "sku_vas": ["Engraving"],
              "sku_gift_message": "To Mom, with love",
              "sku_etching_message": "Name: John Doe"
            }
          ],
          "billing_address_attributes": { ... },
          "shipping_address_attributes": { ... },
          "carrier": { "carrier_code": "DHL", "carrier_name": "DHL Express" }
        }
      }
      ```

      #### 4. Order with Serial Numbers (IMEI/USN)
      ```json
      {
        "b2c_order": {
          "shipping_type": "standard_delivery",
          "payment_collection_name": "cod",
          "currency_code": "INR",
          "is_fbs_order": true,
          "delivery_date": "2026-03-31",
          "reference_number": "2026032600173401",
          "serialized_inputs": true,
          "carrier": {
            "carrier_code": "18h",
            "carrier_name": "SAMART LASTMILES DELIVERY",
            "carrier_email": "",
            "carrier_contact_number": ""
          },
          "additional_attribute_attributes": {
            "extra_details": null,
            "seller_store_code": null,
            "do_number": "2026032600173401"
          },
          "adjustment_attributes": {
            "sub_total": 3,
            "discount": 0,
            "shipping_cost": 0,
            "tax_amount": 0,
            "insurance_amount": 0
          },
          "order_items_attributes": [
            {
              "unit_price": 3,
              "retail_price": 3,
              "selling_price": 3,
              "quantity": 1,
              "serial_numbers": ["Eaa00000040881"],
              "sku": "IMEI-01ath"
            }
          ],
          "billing_address_attributes": {
            "first_name": "Chua",
            "last_name": "",
            "address1": "PJ Warehouse, 51 Seksyen 19",
            "address2": "",
            "address3": "",
            "business_name": "TM SAP-B1",
            "city": "Petaling Jaya",
            "zipcode": "46200",
            "country_iso": "MY",
            "state_abbreviation": "SEL",
            "phone": "0193718413"
          },
          "shipping_address_attributes": {
            "first_name": "Chua",
            "last_name": "",
            "address1": "PJ Warehouse, 51 Seksyen 19",
            "address2": "",
            "address3": "",
            "business_name": "TM SAP-B1",
            "city": "Petaling Jaya",
            "zipcode": "46200",
            "country_iso": "MY",
            "state_abbreviation": "SEL",
            "phone": "0193718413"
          }
        }
      }
      ```

      SCENARIOS:
      - Standard Order: Requires shipping_type, payment_collection_name, order_items, billing/shipping addresses.
      - Cross-Border: Add custom_duty, bill_of_exit, eori.
      - UOM Items: Add uom and uom_quantity in order_items.
      - Marketplace (FBM): Set is_fbm_order=true and marketplace_order_date.
      - Serialized Order: Set serialized_inputs=true and provide serial_numbers per line item (one serial per unit when quantity > 1). Forces FBS allocation by serial number instead of FIFO/LIFO/expiry.

      ### 🔧 VAS (Value Added Services) Parameters
      > **Prerequisite:** The tenant setting `vas_enabled` must be turned ON under **Other** configurations. If disabled, all VAS parameters are silently ignored.

      | Parameter | Level | Type | Description |
      |-----------|-------|------|-------------|
      | `order_vas` | Order | Array/String | VAS codes or names to apply at order level. Accepts array `["Gift Wrapping"]` or comma-separated string `"Gift Wrapping, Quality Check"` |
      | `order_gift_message` | Order | String | Gift message text. Only used when the order has a Gift Message VAS configured |
      | `sku_vas` | Item | Array/String | VAS codes or names to apply at item level (inside `order_items_attributes`) |
      | `sku_gift_message` | Item | String | Gift message for the specific SKU item |
      | `sku_etching_message` | Item | String | Etching/engraving message for the specific SKU item |

      **Notes:**
      - On **create**, VAS IDs are added to the order/item.
      - On **update**, sending `order_vas`/`sku_vas` **replaces** existing VAS (not additive). Sending blank clears them.
      - At most **one Gift Message VAS** per order and per item; at most **one Etching VAS** per item.

      👉 IMPORTANT: Click 'Model' (next to Example Value below) to see detailed conditional requirements for every field.

post.description:
Create a new VAS (Value Added Service) configuration for a specific warehouse.
      The VAS is created in `draft` status. Use the Change Status API to activate it.

      ### 📋 Request Template (Copy & Paste)

      #### 1. Standard VAS (e.g., Shrink Wrapping on Shipment)
      ```json
      {
        "vas": {
          "vas_service_code": "shrink_wrapping",
          "code": "SW-OUTBOUND-001",
          "name": "Shrink Wrapping - Outbound",
          "instructions": "Apply shrink wrap to all items before packing",
          "operational_phase": "outbound",
          "operational_sub_phase": "before_packing",
          "task_level": "shipment",
          "sku_level_enabled": false,
          "preselect_on_creation": true,
          "acknowledgement_type": "user",
          "start_date": "2026-03-01",
          "end_date": "2026-12-31",
          "order_types": ["b2c", "b2b"],
          "company_codes": ["COMP001"],
          "evidences": { "photo": true },
          "vas_custom_attributes_attributes": [
            {
              "input_type": "checkbox",
              "label": "Wrap Type",
              "is_mandatory": true,
              "options": ["Standard", "Premium", "Eco-Friendly"]
            }
          ]
        }
      }
      ```

      #### 2. Gift Message VAS (Order Level)
      ```json
      {
        "vas": {
          "vas_service_code": "gift_message",
          "code": "GM-ORDER-001",
          "name": "Gift Message - Order Level",
          "instructions": "Print gift message on order receipt",
          "operational_phase": "outbound",
          "operational_sub_phase": "before_packing",
          "task_level": "order",
          "sku_level_enabled": false,
          "acknowledgement_type": "system",
          "user_input_field": true,
          "order_types": ["b2c", "b2b"],
          "company_codes": ["COMP001"]
        }
      }
      ```

      #### 3. Etching Message VAS (SKU Level)
      ```json
      {
        "vas": {
          "vas_service_code": "etching",
          "code": "ETCH-SKU-001",
          "name": "Etching - SKU Level",
          "instructions": "Engrave personalized text on product",
          "operational_phase": "outbound",
          "operational_sub_phase": "before_packing",
          "task_level": "shipment",
          "sku_level_enabled": true,
          "acknowledgement_type": "user",
          "user_input_field": true,
          "order_types": ["b2c", "b2b"],
          "company_codes": ["COMP001"]
        }
      }
      ```

      #### 4. Inbound VAS (e.g., Price Tagging on PO)
      ```json
      {
        "vas": {
          "vas_service_code": "price_tagging",
          "code": "PT-INBOUND-001",
          "name": "Price Tagging - Inbound",
          "instructions": "Attach price tag to each item during receiving",
          "operational_phase": "inbound",
          "operational_sub_phase": "receive",
          "task_level": "grn",
          "sku_level_enabled": false,
          "acknowledgement_type": "user",
          "order_types": ["po"],
          "company_codes": ["COMP001"]
        }
      }
      ```

      ### Validation Rules
      | Rule | Condition |
      |---|---|
      | Order-level VAS | When `task_level` = `order`: `sku_level_enabled` must be `false`, `acknowledgement_type` must be `system` |
      | Gift Message (Order) | `operational_phase`: `outbound`, `task_level`: `order`, `order_types`: only `b2c` and/or `b2b` |
      | Gift Message (SKU) | `operational_phase`: `outbound`, `task_level`: `shipment`, `sku_level_enabled`: `true`, `order_types`: only `b2c` and/or `b2b` |
      | Etching Message | Same as Gift Message (SKU) — only at shipment level with `sku_level_enabled`: `true` |
      | Valid order_types | `b2c`, `b2b`, `sto`, `flow_through`, `po` |

      ### Important Notes
      - VAS is always created in `draft` status. Use the **Change Status API** to activate it
      - Either `vas_service_code` or `vas_service_name` is required to identify the VAS service master
      - `order_types` accepts both array format `["b2c", "b2b"]` and comma-separated string `"b2c,b2b"`
      - `company_codes` auto-includes child companies. Alternatively, use `company_ids: ["all"]` to select all warehouse companies

      ### Edge Cases & Error Scenarios
      | Scenario | Error Response |
      |---|---|
      | Neither `vas_service_code` nor `vas_service_name` provided | 500 - "Either vas_service_code or vas_service_name is required" |
      | `vas_service_code` does not exist | 500 - "VAS Service not found with code: {code}" |
      | `vas_service_name` does not exist | 500 - "VAS Service not found with name: {name}" |
      | `company_codes` contains invalid codes | 500 - "Companies not found with codes: {codes}" |
      | `order_types` contains invalid values | 500 - "Invalid order types: {types}" (valid: b2c, b2b, sto, flow_through, po) |
      | Model validation fails (missing required fields) | 400 - Validation error messages |

      ### Prerequisites
      - `vas_enabled` setting must be ON (Configuration → Other → Value Added Services)

Update an existing VAS configuration. Fields that can be updated depend on the current status of the VAS.

      ### 📋 Request Templates (Copy & Paste)

      #### 1. Update Draft VAS (all fields editable)
      ```json
      {
        "vas": {
          "name": "Updated Gift Wrapping",
          "instructions": "Updated: Use eco-friendly wrapping paper",
          "operational_phase": "outbound",
          "operational_sub_phase": "before_packing",
          "task_level": "shipment",
          "sku_level_enabled": false,
          "acknowledgement_type": "user",
          "order_types": ["b2c", "b2b", "sto"],
          "company_codes": ["COMP001", "COMP002"],
          "vas_custom_attributes_attributes": [
            {
              "input_type": "checkbox",
              "label": "Wrapping Color",
              "is_mandatory": true,
              "options": ["Red", "Blue", "Gold", "Silver"]
            }
          ]
        }
      }
      ```

      #### 2. Update Active VAS (instructions only)
      ```json
      {
        "vas": {
          "instructions": "Updated: Use eco-friendly wrapping paper and recycled ribbon"
        }
      }
      ```

      #### 3. Update Paused/Archived VAS (instructions + companies)
      ```json
      {
        "vas": {
          "instructions": "Updated instructions for paused VAS",
          "company_codes": ["COMP001", "COMP003"]
        }
      }
      ```

      #### 4. Delete a Custom Attribute (draft only)
      ```json
      {
        "vas": {
          "vas_custom_attributes_attributes": [
            {
              "label": "Old Field",
              "delete_attribute": true
            }
          ]
        }
      }
      ```

      ### Status-Based Restrictions
      | Current Status | Editable Fields |
      |---|---|
      | **draft** | All fields |
      | **active** | `instructions` only |
      | **paused** | `instructions`, `company_codes` |
      | **archived** | `instructions`, `company_codes` |

      ### Custom Attributes Update Behavior
      | Action | How to |
      |---|---|
      | **Create** new attribute | Send new `label` with `input_type` |
      | **Update** existing attribute | Send same `label` with updated fields |
      | **Delete** existing attribute | Send `label` + `delete_attribute: true` |
      | **Keep** unchanged | Omit from payload |

      ### Important Notes
      - `order_types` accepts both array format `["b2c", "b2b"]` and comma-separated string `"b2c,b2b"`
      - `company_codes` auto-includes child companies. Alternatively, use `company_ids: ["all"]` to select all warehouse companies

      ### Edge Cases & Error Scenarios
      | Scenario | Error Response |
      |---|---|
      | VAS code not found | 404 - "VAS not found" |
      | Updating restricted fields on **active** VAS (e.g., `name`) | 400 - "Name cannot be modified when VAS is Active. Only Instructions can be updated" |
      | Updating restricted fields on **paused/archived** VAS (e.g., `name`) | 400 - "Name cannot be modified when VAS is Paused. Only Instructions, Company codes can be updated" |
      | Modifying `vas_custom_attributes_attributes` on non-draft VAS | 400 - Status-based restriction error (custom attributes are draft-only) |

put.description:
Change the status of a VAS configuration. Only specific transitions are allowed based on the current status.

      ### 📋 URL Examples (Copy & Paste)
      ```
      # Activate a draft VAS:
      PUT /rest/v1/warehouses/WH001/vas/GW-001/change_status/activate

      # Pause an active VAS:
      PUT /rest/v1/warehouses/WH001/vas/GW-001/change_status/pause

      # Re-activate a paused VAS:
      PUT /rest/v1/warehouses/WH001/vas/GW-001/change_status/activate

      # Archive a paused VAS:
      PUT /rest/v1/warehouses/WH001/vas/GW-001/change_status/archive
      ```

      ### Status Transitions
      | Current Status | Allowed Actions | Resulting Status |
      |---|---|---|
      | **draft** | `activate` | active |
      | **active** | `pause` | paused |
      | **paused** | `activate` | active |
      | **paused** | `archive` | archived |
      | **archived** | *(none)* | — |

      ### Status Lifecycle
      ```
      draft → activate → active → pause → paused → activate → active
                                                   ↘ archive → archived (terminal)
      ```

      ### Edge Cases & Error Scenarios
      | Scenario | Error Response |
      |---|---|
      | VAS code not found | 404 - "VAS not found" |
      | Invalid `type` value (not activate/pause/archive) | 400 - "Invalid action" |
      | Attempting to archive a draft VAS (draft → archive) | 400 - "Cannot Archive. VAS is Draft. Allowed: Activate" |
      | Attempting to pause a draft VAS (draft → pause) | 400 - "Cannot Pause. VAS is Draft. Allowed: Activate" |
      | Attempting to activate an active VAS (active → activate) | 400 - "Cannot Activate. VAS is Active. Allowed: Pause" |
      | Attempting any transition on archived VAS | 400 - "Archived VAS cannot be transitioned" |
      | Model save fails after status change | 400 - Validation error messages |

      ### Prerequisites
      - `vas_enabled` setting must be ON (Configuration → Other → Value Added Services)
